bootstrap_command: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates procps

network_isolation.scope: Image/bootstrap and anonymous Git acquisition used network; every Allagma and conformance command below ran after disconnect. No host workspace, credentials or sockets were mounted.

virtualization: Local Docker Desktop Linux VM on macOS arm64; native aarch64 container, not x86 emulation
